title: blob info cache sqlite, use same options as podman sqlite db
body:
ref https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/29733

We likely should keep the sqlite options we use alligned between two as I do not see a reason two use different defaults for both dbs. IF we know one works then the other one should as well to avoid unexpected behaviours.

cc @mheon @mtrmac
